scope: Public documentation and metadata audit; no additional measurement outcomes, fitting, physical calibration or demonstrated decision benefit.

findings: Table S1 confirms one-second high-flux acquisitions and the 3,964,445-event count for the 198 ns setting.
The authors discuss afterpulsing and laser-power-dependent pulse shape; these are not an independent calibration of our fitted timing-history contrast.
The mannequin reference is a longer low-flux acquisition. The additional high-signal experiment has only approximate target distance in the inspected description.
No submillimeter timing-reference uncertainty, original synchronization headers or acquisition identity for laser_calib_100.mat was identified.

highflux_source_tree.scope: Repository tree and previously read analysis files; this is not an exhaustive content audit of every blob. No acquisition/conversion implementation was identified.

public_issues.scope: No items returned at retrieval; not a claim about future issues or private correspondence.

manufacturer_reader.finding: The official HydraHarp T3 reader separates an overflow-corrected synchronization counter from relative-delay ticks. Compatibility with this representation does not establish the acquisition mode or conversion used for the supplied MAT files.

license_boundary: The supplement license does not establish permission to redistribute the raw measurement archive; raw measurements and downloaded source documents remain outside Git.
disposition: The selected physical-validation route remains blocked on external calibration/provenance evidence. The stationary correction remains parked after its failed comparative gate. This audit neither establishes benefit nor exhausts other possible research directions.
